signals.summary: Reco expanded its operations by opening a physical office in Texas and establishing a dedicated team in the United Kingdom and Ireland.
signals.evidence: Reco, which provides an AI security platform focused on discovering, governing and securing AI agents, identities and SaaS connections, announced several leadership appointments alongside new operations in Texas and the United Kingdom and Ireland.

signals.summary: Reco appointed Zoe Hillenmeyer as chief operating officer.
signals.evidence: Among the leadership additions is Zoe Hillenmeyer, who has been appointed chief operating officer.

signals.summary: Reco named Kristen Twining as senior vice president of Americas sales and business development.
signals.evidence: The company also named Kristen Twining senior vice president of Americas sales and business development.

signals.summary: Reco appointed Dana Harduf as chief human resources officer.
signals.evidence: Additional appointments include Dana Harduf as chief human resources officer

signals.summary: Reco appointed Sandy Mathews as vice president of product marketing.
signals.evidence: Sandy Mathews as vice president of product marketing

signals.summary: Merav Keren Kindler was appointed vice president of marketing at Reco.
signals.evidence: Merav Keren Kindler as vice president of marketing.

signals.summary: Reco received three Global InfoSec Awards for 2026 in SaaS and cloud security, AI security solutions, and generative AI cybersecurity categories.
signals.evidence: The company recently received three Global InfoSec Awards for 2026, including recognition in SaaS and cloud security, AI security solutions and generative AI cybersecurity categories.
